faction.AnCom.desc:
Hexarch AnCom describes itself as a publishing business group. It is the largest producer of media content in the System. AnCom employs a huge staff of writers, screenwriters, film producers, video game developers and so on. All this makes AnCom one of the most influential companies in the System. Through entertainment content, AnCom promotes the values ​​of anarcho-capitalism. It may not be the richest hexarch, but AnCom's commitment to the values ​​of the AnCap system is beyond doubt.

It’s well-known that AnCom has a powerful research division. It is unclear to many in the System what exactly these well-hidden research teams are doing. Due to our close work with AnCom in the past, we know that these studies focus on quasimorphosis.

Nobody can trace the history of AnCom precisely. The corporation seems to have simply appeared out of nowhere shortly before the Great Anarchist Revolution. However, we know of a media conglomerate called the Eurasian Literary Society (ELS). It was this conglomerate that became the foundation for AnCom. ELS was owned by a major Eurasian businessman. He is rumored to have been a follower of ancient esoteric teachings. At some point, ELS shareholders forced the owner to step down from managing the company, and it grew rich from the production and sale of entertainment content. Then ELS began buying up the last independent studios and publishing houses, after which it transformed into AnCom. AnCom Corporation took an active part in the Revolution, sponsoring the formation of private armies and buying off mercenaries from the nation states.

Vicious tongues call AnCom the “propaganda ministry” of the AnCap system. This is not far from the truth. All hexarchs can afford to operate in any field of activity. They are all engaged in production, deliveries, energy production and scientific activity. However, each hexarch invests most heavily in building a specific and unique profile, where it is simply impossible to compete with them. AnCom's focus is entertainment. However, its films, books and video games are literally stuffed with anarcho-capitalist propaganda. AnCom makes action movies in which the hero shoots hordes of Civil Resistance colnodes, as well as historical strategy games about the days of the Great Anarchist Revolution.

Recently, the corporation has been creating content in which the protagonist destroys hordes of monsters and hosts of demons. One popular, endless AnCom series is a screen adaptation of Robert E. Howard's books about Conan the Barbarian, who saves humanity from various monsters. There is also an extremely popular series of games about the conquistadors of Cortes, conquering the nightmarish and disgusting civilizations of Mesoamerica.
faction.AnCom.name: AnCom
faction.AnCom.shortdesc:
Leadership: Inner Rite consisting of nine members, Voice of the Rite Geoffroi Molay
Headquarters: HIS Unveiled (Venus)

System-scale publisher, research corporation.
faction.AnCom.tradedesc: Hello. Have you brought any books? My apologies... I didn't immediately understand who you are. We accept the following from you:
faction.CattaramFeral.name: Cattaram
faction.ChurchGannix.desc:
The Emerald Temple was once simply a large religious corporation in the Solar System. Now, it is the premier conduit of Tezctlan's will among humanity. The Emerald Temple originated on Earth and constantly guided people toward the true faith. When the moment of truth arrived, Quetzal-Pope John Paul VI revealed the true purpose of their service to millions of believers.

Ever since the gates to Tezctlan were opened, the Emerald Temple has become the center of a new revelation. Now humanity knows the meaning of genuine divine terror.

The corporation is organized on the principle of a sacred pyramid. The higher the clearance level, the closer one is to the emerald radiance of the true master of the Solar System. The lower levels are served by laypeople and missionary pilgrims, who receive revelation from the taltnoms and gladly surrender their gavvakh whenever the masters require it. The middle tier is occupied by the priests, who interpret the will of Tezctlan. At the summit stands the Quetzal-Pope himself, the patriarch and herald, who holds a monopoly on personal communion with Tezctlan.

The history of the Emerald Temple is being written right now. Everything prior to the Great Reconfession doesn't matter—it was merely a glitch. Now the corporation acts as the official church of the Emerald Empire.
faction.ChurchGannix.name: Emerald Temple
faction.ChurchGannix.shortdesc:
Quetzal-Pope: John Paul VI
Headquarters: Carcosa (Titan)

The Church of the Emerald Empire. Tezctlan is the new god of humanity. The Emerald Temple is the herald of his will.
faction.ChurchGannix.tradedesc: Welcome beneath the vault of the Emerald Temple. Here is what we shall never renounce:
faction.ChurchRevelation.desc:
The Church of Revelation is the largest religious organization in the Solar System. It provides high-quality religious services on a commercial basis. The Church’s main goal is to satisfy the spiritual needs of any individual who seeks revelation and meaning in a world devoid of the foundation of such false concepts as “patriotism.” The Church of Revelation is aimed at the widest possible audience: from believers seeking salvation to those interested only in the therapeutic aspects of spiritual practice.

The organization sells a variety of religious goods, from ritual objects and amulets to high-tech interfaces for creating personalized religious experiences. It also has a strong presence in the media space, producing educational programs and “spiritual excursions” where anyone can take the path to revelation according to their tastes—from a gentle existential search to intense mystical practices. For a very high price, the Church of Revelation can organize a pilgrimage to Earth to visit the preserved holy sites.

The Church has a policy of openness and inclusivity, allowing each individual to choose how they wish to engage with their faith. Services are provided in the form of individual rituals as well as mass gatherings held at Church-owned assets throughout the System. The

history of the Church of Revelation originates from several ecumenical movements that sought to unite various religious movements in the mid-21st century. In the chaos of wars, these movements contributed to the centralization of different branches of one ancient religion around a small theocracy in Europe. After the Great Anarchist Revolution, ecumenical movements were forced to adapt to new conditions. This led to the appearance of the Church of Revelation. It was the first to be formalized as a corporation, taking a dominant position and offering a universal set of rituals and concepts that corresponded to any spiritual needs.
faction.ChurchRevelation.name: Church of Revelation
faction.ChurchRevelation.tradedesc: Welcome to our holy ground. We’re always ready to accept:
faction.CivilUnity.desc:
The Civil Unity faction emerged as a reaction to the betrayal of those who sided with reactionary forces and began forging alliances with the quasimorphs. This is a betrayal of the very meaning of the struggle. Unity rejects not only the anarcho-capitalist system but any form of supernatural interference in humanity’s future. We must remain human. At any cost!

Unlike the Civil Resistance, Unity has abandoned the idea of restoring the nation states. The new concept is technological citizenship, rebuilt from scratch. The Collective Mind of Humanity, Issaсhar, has accumulated enough computational power and infrastructure to eventually absorb all of humanity and become the perfect ruler. All of unified humanity will govern itself collectively.

Issaсhar believes the world can only be saved through total organization.
faction.CivilUnity.name: Civil Unity
faction.CivilUnity.shortdesc:
The Collective Mind of Humanity: Issachar
Headquarters: Sundog Zone (Deimos)

Public enemy. Architects of technocratic neo-humanism.
faction.CivilUnity.tradedesc: Welcome to the Unity base. Here is a list for consolidating our material foundation:
faction.CoreWard.desc:
CoreWard MG (Mining Group) is a mining corporation specializing in the development of asteroids and planetary mining systems. Its main activity is the extraction of minerals from the depths of celestial bodies, including ore, rare earth elements and ice deposits from the asteroids of the Outer System. CoreWard MG controls a vast network of mines, tunnels and processing complexes, turning harsh asteroids and planetary masses into resource sources for the entire AnCap system.

Abandoned mines, deep tunnels and depleted asteroids are all that CoreWard MG leaves behind. In the face of fierce competition and the constant threat of pirate attacks, the corporation continues to delve into the most remote corners of the Solar System. The hard work of mining is accompanied by complex operations to ensure safety and maintain working conditions in harsh environments where even air costs a fortune.

CoreWard MG is also actively developing its educational programs, offering training in the fields of geology and mining. These programs are designed to prepare highly qualified specialists who are able to work effectively in deep space conditions. The corporation’s students are trained in the latest methods of analysis and processing of materials necessary for successful extraction in the extreme conditions of space objects.

The history of CoreWard MG begins with the first expeditions to Mars, when resource extraction outside Earth became both economically feasible and necessary. Since then, the corporation has built a powerful infrastructure capable of operating on the most inhospitable objects in the Solar System. After the Great Anarchist Revolution CoreWard MG became the leader in the production pyramid of the AnCap system, providing all other market players with raw materials. The particularly brutal working conditions for low-ranking workers mean that escapees from the CoreWard MG mines are more likely than others to join the ranks of the Civil Resistance.
faction.CoreWard.name: Coreward MG
faction.CoreWard.shortdesc:
Chairman of the Board : Kwamena Asamoah
Headquarters: Rachmaninov-Energia (Mercury)

Mining corporation.
faction.CoreWard.tradedesc: Hey there. We’d be happy to discuss trade for the following:
faction.CResistance.desc:
The Civil Resistance (CR) is a terrorist organization waging a long-term struggle against the anarcho-capitalist order and the AnCap system. Its goal is to restore states, which, in the CR’s opinion, are capable of returning control and order, "which it prefers to the unbridled chaos of anarcho-capitalism". Despite the dubious goal of restoring the old state system and comprehensive control over personal freedom, the CR continues to recruit supporters among low-ranking workers who have lost faith in equal opportunities.

The CR’s operations are always carefully planned and covert. Even if they resort to direct actions, it always comes as a surprise.

The CR soldiers, known as colnodes, are humans altered by advanced psychotechniques, pharmaceuticals and biotechnology, allowing them to act with unprecedented cruelty and endurance. The central hypothesis regarding the nature of colnodes is that they do not possess so-called phenomenal consciousness, which in normal people wastes too much energy and inhibits natural reflexes. Colnodes are known for their astounding combat effectiveness and ruthlessness. There is a theory that they do not feel pain, fear or other human emotions, recognizing these states only as indicators: damage, danger and so on. It is believed that these changes allow them to fight to the last, without fear of death. It is possible that this is not a result of psychotechnics and medicine. Some sociologists believe that the CR uses enough propaganda to manipulate consciousness and deprive people of basic human qualities in the name of its fanatical goal.

The organization’s roots lie in the remnants of the old state armies that were defeated in the fight against the corporations during theGreat Anarchist Revolution. These supposedly became underground groups, which laid the foundation for the CR. However, it is unclear how and why these groups turned into an army of colnodes and where they acquired the relevant technologies.

Although the CR fights to restore what it calls "order and justice," in reality it seeks to return humanity to the control of state institutions, which, as everyone knows, is nothing more than a form of slavery. The actions of the CR cause significant damage to corporations, making the Civil Resistance a significant threat to the AnCap system.
faction.CResistance.name: Civil Resistance
faction.CResistance.shortdesc:
Leadership: General Secretary Leah, separate cells (colcones)
Headquarters: [?]

A terrorist organization fighting to restore the nation states.
faction.CResistance.tradedesc: Comrade! It's finally time for expropriation. Here’s what we need in this area of the struggle:
faction.DaydreamChems.desc:
Daydream Chem is a corporation that sits at the top of the System's chemical industry. It is especially famous for its achievements in the production of psychoactive substances. The company's products are popular in literally all strata of the AnCap system: among those who want to relax, among scientists if they need to speed up their minds or suppress ethical regulators, and, of course, among the military. The chemical compounds developed in Daydream Chem laboratories are characterized by their ultra-high efficiency.

Of course, a significant number of medical products circulating in the System were introduced into the market by Daydream Chem.

Curiously, not all market agents want to advertise supplies from the corporation. For products on the border between medicines and psychoactive drugs, Daydream Chem delivers them. This ensures the anonymity of the buyer. It is very likely that a significant number of corporations that need to enhance the capabilities of their employees (from CoreWard MG to RealWare) are supplied by Daydream Chem.

The history of Daydream Chem began as an anarcho-capitalist dream. A group of independent pharmacists decided to create unique substances to alter the perception of reality. After the Great Anarchist Revolution, they were no longer held back by regulatory laws and imaginary restrictions. Over time, their success led to integration with larger pharmaceutical concerns, where these chemists immediately took key positions.
faction.DaydreamChems.name: Daydream Chem
faction.DaydreamChems.shortdesc:
Chairman of the Board : Nathalie Lettmann
Headquarters: Avicenna Clinic (Fuller)

Chemical and pharmaceutical industries.
faction.DaydreamChems.tradedesc: Welcome to our company's territory. Below is the list of accepted goods:
faction.Dilthey.desc:
Dilthey is an engineering hypercorporation. Dilthey’s envious admirers or embittered competitors—which, in the AnCap system, is often the same thing—sometimes call the hypercorporation the Keeper of the Belt. Dilthey’s incredible achievements remind us that success comes to those who are able to combine fundamental science and engineering excellence, new social conditions and an irrepressible desire to improve human life.

The Dilthey Corporation can best be described by looking back at its history. Having grown out of the ruins of the old order amid the Great Anarchist Revolution, the corporation is not the direct successor of any major conglomerate. At the beginning of its journey, several medical corporations teamed up with an ambitious engineering concern in order to research human adaptation to life in space. The medical part of the corporation focused on psychology and psychiatry, conducting numerous studies on how the human psyche reacts to the new extreme conditions of the cosmic environment. The results of this research allowed Dilthey’s engineering branch to develop space stations and residential complexes that took into account the psychological and physiological needs of humans.

During the fierce conflicts on Earth and Mars, Dilthey did not engage in direct combat, focusing instead on reclaiming the Main Belt and some of the Outer System’s moons. Despite this, Dilthey’s propaganda claims that the hypercorporation played a decisive role in securing the GAR's victory in these regions, defending them from loyalist and civilian armies. These conflicts were less destructive than the battles on the inner planets, but allowed Dilthey to consolidate its position and pave the way for the hypercorporation’s future dominance in space engineering.

Today, Dilthey is one of the leading players in the construction and exploration of space. The corporation implements projects to create artificial planets, build cities inside asteroids and change the orbits of small celestial bodies. In addition, the corporation offers educational programs in space engineering, applied psychology, space sociology and even new philosophy. These programs are especially popular among those who want not only to work in space, but also to take part in its transformation for the benefit of corporations.
faction.Dilthey.name: Dilthey
faction.Dilthey.tradedesc: Your products must meet our requirements. Here’s what we need:
faction.DuggurFeral.name: Duggur
faction.Emeraldlight.desc:
The Emerald Coven is a corporation whose existence embodies the idea of spiritual constancy in an age of change. When the Sunlight Coven fell beneath the inexorable advance of the new master of the Solar System, the era of misguided mystics ended, and the era of new priests began.

The Emerald Coven asserts that the spirit of High Priest MacLathagain was preserved and reincarnated to serve Tezctlan. The new High Priest—a cloned and enhanced version of the founder—leads the Coven, guided not by emotion, but by the perfect knowledge of his past mistakes.

Now, the Coven has become a part of the Emerald Empire and serves as its spiritual and scientific institution. It unites pharmaceutical research with mysticism, and psychoactive therapy with rituals of transcendence. Unlike the old religions that offered only belief, the Emerald Coven offers a measurable result: the restoration of harmony between biochemistry and the spirit.

The corporation's archives contain copies of the ancient texts of the Coven, but now they are interpreted as a harbinger of the Emerald Revelation. Where once they spoke of the goddess of the Moon, they now mention the radiance of Venus. Where once they sang of free will, they now preach unity with the Emerald Light.

And yet, the corporation is proud of its heritage. They claim that the High Priest died and was reborn not in vain. His sacrifice proved that even false ideals can be purified, and that one who wandered in darkness can be utilized for eternal service to Tezctlan.
faction.Emeraldlight.name: Emerald Coven
faction.Emeraldlight.shortdesc:
High Priest: purified of delusion Eric MacLatagain

Headquarters: Pilgrim's Rift (Hyperion)

A pharmaco-religious corporation. The spiritual and neurochemical research center of the Emerald Empire.
faction.Emeraldlight.tradedesc: May the emerald balance of matter and spirit dwell within you. May your formula align with ours.
